description: Alpine hiking trail to Mirror Lake. Elevation +/- 1955m . From the lake looking West is Tsuius Mtn elevation 2487 m / 8159 ft.
directions:
Access is via Sugar lake Forest Service Road. From Cherryville BC travel North to Sugar Lake. Stay to the West until you get onto the Sugar Lake FSR. Note all FSR roads will vary in condition and are industrial roads may require 4x4 vehicle.
53 km from Vernon to Cherryville Turn north onto Sugar Lake Road at Franks Store Travel for approx. 16 km on paved road. At this point you will be near the south end of Sugar Lake and crossing a bridge at the lower end of Sugar Lake and will travel the Forest Service Road Sugar Lake for 49.3 km, near the end you would have crossed a bridge winded up an incline come to a Y junction. Turn Left heading up the mountain 8.6 km, about 270 meters before the end (which is the Monasheee Powdercats Lodge) will be a road to the right which will take you to the Trail head about 192 meters in.
title: Tsuius Mountain
